description: Batched ContextBench run comparing baseline Claude Code against Claude Code with Cortex MCP initialized and explicit full-tool Cortex workflow guidance before each scored benchmark task.

variants.name: baseline
variants.description: Run Claude Code without any additional MCP servers or Cortex resources.
variants.notes: Explicit control variant. Uses the same Claude model, reasoning effort, and timeout as the base run, with no additional runtime resources.

variants.name: with-cortex-mcp
variants.description: Install Cortex, bootstrap the repository index, expose its MCP server to Claude Code, and guide Claude through search/related/rules/impact Cortex workflow before normal file inspection.
variants.notes: Installs the pinned Cortex MCP package into the isolated Claude runtime, runs Cortex init plus the generated bootstrap pipeline, validates ingest/graph/embedding artifacts, exposes Cortex as an MCP server, and prompts Claude to use the full Cortex navigation workflow.

setup.prompt_preamble: Cortex MCP is connected and pre-indexed for this repository. Use Cortex as the primary repository-navigation workflow before normal file inspection. Start with mcp__cortex__context_search to locate likely files, symbols, tests, and concepts before broad Grep, Read, Glob, or Bash-based search. For the most relevant search result, call mcp__cortex__context_get_related before reading files so you can inspect related symbols, tests, callers, callees, or neighboring context. Before editing, call mcp__cortex__context_get_rules for the relevant file, symbol, or concept when available. After choosing or applying a fix, call mcp__cortex__context_impact on the changed file or symbol to identify likely affected areas and tests. Use normal Read, Grep, Edit, and Bash after Cortex has guided discovery. Do not inspect .context/** directly with Grep, Read, Glob, or Bash; treat .context/** as Cortex implementation data and access Cortex context only through MCP tools. Do not use mcp__cortex__context_reload during the scored task unless Cortex explicitly reports a stale or missing index; bootstrap has already indexed the repository. Continue to a concrete solution; do not stop at analysis-only output.

runtime_validation_commands_add: cortex --version > "$CONTEXTBENCH_TASK_DIR/cortex-version.txt" && node -e "const pkg=require(process.env.HOME + '/.local/lib/node_modules/@danielblomma/cortex-mcp/package.json'); if (pkg.version !== '2.0.13') { console.error('Expected @danielblomma/cortex-mcp 2.0.13, got ' + pkg.version); process.exit(1); }"

test -x "$HOME/.local/bin/cortex" && test -x ./scripts/context.sh && test -f .context/config.yaml && test -f .context/rules.yaml && test -f .context/ontology.cypher && test -f .context/mcp/dist/server.js && test -s .context/cache/manifest.json && test -s .context/cache/documents.jsonl && test -s .context/cache/entities.file.jsonl && test -s .context/cache/graph-manifest.json && test -e .context/db/graph.ryu && test -s .context/embeddings/manifest.json && test -s .context/embeddings/entities.jsonl

node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const read=(p)=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m); process.exit(1);}; const ingest=read('.context/cache/manifest.json'); const graph=read('.context/cache/graph-manifest.json'); const embed=read('.context/embeddings/manifest.json'); if (Number(ingest.counts?.files||0)<=0) fail('Cortex bootstrap validation failed: ingest produced no files'); if (Number(graph.counts?.files||0)<=0) fail('Cortex bootstrap validation failed: graph load produced no files'); if (Number(embed.counts?.entities||0)<=0 || Number(embed.counts?.output||0)<=0) fail('Cortex bootstrap validation failed: embeddings produced no indexed entities');"

tmp_dir="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/contextbench-cortex-mcp-smoke-$$"; mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"; fifo="$tmp_dir/stdin"; mkfifo "$fifo"; CORTEX_PROJECT_ROOT="${CONTEXTBENCH_WORKSPACE_PATH:-$PWD}" cortex mcp < "$fifo" > "$tmp_dir/stdout.log" 2> "$tmp_dir/stderr.log" & pid=$!; exec 3>"$fifo"; sleep 2; if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then wait "$pid"; status=$?; cat "$tmp_dir/stderr.log" >&2; exec 3>&-; rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; exit "$status"; fi; exec 3>&-; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$tmp_dir"

for path in .gitignore AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md docs/architecture.md docs/cortex-architecture.md scripts mcp .claude .githooks; do git restore --staged --worktree -- "$path" 2>/dev/null || true; done; git clean -fdx -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md docs/architecture.md docs/cortex-architecture.md scripts mcp .claude .githooks .npm-cache
